title: Pig eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- pig body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='30' ry='24' fill='#f79ab4'/>
  <!-- body shading -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='26' ry='16' fill='#f28aa8'/>
  <!-- back legs -->
  <rect x='28' y='78' width='9' height='12' rx='4' fill='#e9789a'/>
  <rect x='60' y='78' width='9' height='12' rx='4' fill='#e9789a'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='28' y='86' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#c95d80'/>
  <rect x='60' y='86' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#c95d80'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='22' fill='#fca9c1'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M32 22 Q28 10 40 18 Z' fill='#f189a8'/>
  <path d='M68 22 Q72 10 60 18 Z' fill='#f189a8'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='34' r='3.5' fill='#5b2b45'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='34' r='3.5' fill='#5b2b45'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='33' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='33' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#f47ba0'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='46' rx='2.5' ry='3.5' fill='#b84f74'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='46' rx='2.5' ry='3.5' fill='#b84f74'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='44' r='4' fill='#f9b8cd'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='44' r='4' fill='#f9b8cd'/>
  <!-- snack: cookie held near mouth -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='8' fill='#e0a95c'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='8' fill='none' stroke='#c98a3c' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='58' r='1.3' fill='#8a5a24'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='59' r='1.3' fill='#8a5a24'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='63' r='1.3' fill='#8a5a24'/>
  <!-- front hoof holding cookie -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='66' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#f28aa8'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='66' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#f28aa8'/>
  <!-- little tail -->
  <path d='M80 56 q8 -4 4 -10 q-4 -4 -6 2' fill='none' stroke='#f28aa8' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
